posts.title: So Twisted Fate
posts.description: hm, life update: Got hired at Starbucks at the end of June, now it's the end of September, and I got a call two days ago that Starbucks execs decided to close down a handful of unionized stores and that mine was one of them. I have one more shift tomorrow, and then we're closed forever. There goes my only way of affording college (Through Starbucks' ASU Online program). Did my fair share of crying

posts.title: existence is exhausting
posts.description: my life is falling apart right before my very eyes, yeowowow! i was not made for this life path, i want to do my own thing and be creative. everything is so exhausting. i know i will perservere but i just want some time off. i wish i could throw my phone into the ocean. existence is exhausting.

posts.title: Ashamed
posts.description: Motivation is fleeting. Discipline is soft. I've been very numb these days. Was I always like this? I want to write poetry. And to find myself. I can do whatever I want, and yet I do nothing at all.
